messages:
Sam (OrbitMax): Hi team — onboarding hit a weird combo: some requests to /v1/embeddings return 403 insufficient_scope, and we also see a lot of 429 spikes right after we enabled the SDK auto-retry plugin. started after upgrading node sdk to v1.4.2. staging only.
Leah (CSM): thanks Sam. can you paste the minimal error payload + SDK config? and which endpoint exactly (embeddings vs generate)? looping in Marco + Priya.
Sam (OrbitMax): endpoint is /v1/embeddings/batch. minimal error: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden\n{\n  "id":"req_9f4c...",\n  "error":{"type":"insufficient_scope","message":"token missing scope: embeddings.write"}\n}\n
```
Sam (OrbitMax): token is ephemeral from our CI token service. also seeing bursts of 429s with `Retry-After: 0` in some responses, then SDK immediately retries -> more 429s.
Marco (SDK): a couple of things to check: 1) token scopes (payload) 2) our v1.4.2 had a retry-plugin default that didn't respect Retry-After when it's `0`, and maxAttempts defaulted to 6 (oof). can you paste the SDK retry config?
Sam (OrbitMax): config snippet: 
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_TOKEN, retry: { maxAttempts: 6, factor: 1, minTimeout: 100 } })
```
Sam (OrbitMax): sanitized token payload: `{ "sub":"svc-ci", "scopes":["embeddings.read","generate"] , "exp":1690000000 }`
Priya (Support): that payload is missing embeddings.write — that's why the 403s. separate issue from retries. For retries: if Retry-After is 0, the SDK should back off, not hammer. Marco, can you confirm SDK behavior?
Marco (SDK): confirmed: bug tracked as SDK-342. in v1.4.2 our retry plugin treated `Retry-After: 0` as no-delay and retried immediately. workaround: set `respectRetryAfter:true` and increase exponential backoff params, e.g.: 
```
retry: { maxAttempts: 4, factor: 2, minTimeout: 300, respectRetryAfter: true }
```
Marco (SDK): also, for heavy batch onboarding, prefer `maxConcurrency: 8` + batching to avoid per-request rate pressure.
Leah (CSM): actionables: update token scope (OrbitMax), patch SDK config to respect Retry-After (OrbitMax or Marco), and we can request a temporary onboarding bump while you warm up. i'll open the ops ticket.
InfraBot: Ops ticket created: OPS-4201 — "OrbitMax onboarding rate bump" — assignee: infra-ops.
Sam (OrbitMax): updated our token issuer to include `embeddings.write`. changed SDK config to the suggested snippet and lowered concurrency. re-ran a warmup: 403s are gone, 429s down to ~2% (from ~15%).
Priya (Support): nice. leaving a note: if your token issuer rotates keys frequently, ensure CI runners clock is in sync (long `exp` skew can cause weird auth). also watch for newline/truncation when exporting env var tokens.
Marco (SDK): i'll backport a fix for SDK-342 to v1.x and submit a docs patch recommending the `respectRetryAfter` flag and sensible defaults for onboarding. PR -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/223
Leah (CSM): i'll keep OPS-4201 open for 48 hours and check back. Sam, want a brief enablement call to review best practices?
Sam (OrbitMax): that would be great — 30m tomorrow works. thanks everyone! :tada:
Leah (CSM): excellent, scheduling. summary / next steps: 1) OrbitMax add embeddings.write to token issuer (Sam) 2) OrbitMax adjust retry & concurrency (Sam) 3) Marco patch SDK & docs (Marco) 4) Leah monitor OPS-4201 and schedule enablement (Leah). closing thread after enablement. :memo:
